current_answer: For a live site whose layout is sound but whose type or colors need work, first inspect representative screenshots and ask for a small token-level change in the existing codebase. Do not use Anthropic Web Artifacts Builder for that job: its current instructions package complex claude.ai artifacts into one HTML file. If the target screen or user outcome is unclear, write a brief before choosing a design skill. Product Design Ideate is conditional for comparing visual directions after that brief; Anthropic Frontend Design is a visual-direction guide, not a guaranteed improvement. No listed skill has a pool-run result comparison against a careful no-skill brief.

catalogue_card.question: Is this a live site or a chat artifact?
catalogue_card.text: For a live site with a sound layout, inspect screenshots and change its own type or color tokens first. Anthropic Web Artifacts Builder packages complex Claude chat artifacts into one HTML file; it is not a website-redesign shortcut. Neither route has a pool-run result test.

summary: For a live site with acceptable layout, start with its screenshots, tokens, and a bounded change in its actual codebase.
Anthropic Web Artifacts Builder packages complex claude.ai artifacts into one HTML file; hold it outside the general website-redesign shortlist.
Anthropic Frontend Design gives visual-direction guidance for new or reshaped UI; its current source and outcomes remain untested here.
No listed skill has a pool-run no-skill comparison.
